subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 4 – Consolidation 1: Family grammar and the song
outcomes: I can say who people are: He's my dad. She's my mum.
I can read a description and find the right face.
I can complete the song with the missing words.

tf.why: Yes! In the family tree, Ahmed is dad.
Mum is a woman, so we say She's my mum.

tf.s: Big eyes and small eyes are different.
tf.why: Well done! Big is the opposite of small.
A brother is a boy: He's my brother.

tf.s: In the song: This is my sister. Her name's Claire.
tf.why: Yes! Claire is the sister in the song.

tf.s: Ears and mouth are face words.
tf.why: Great! They are on our face and head.

tf.s: Red and black are family words.
He's got small eyes is about a girl.
tf.why: He is for a boy or a man.

boxes.why: Ahmed is dad in the family tree.
Amna is mum in the family tree.
A sister is a girl: She's.
A brother is a boy: He's.

boxes.q: This is my ___. Her name's Claire.
boxes.why: Her is for a girl: sister.
Big is the opposite of small.
The mouth is on our face.
A brother is in our family.
Grandma is a woman: She's my grandma.

mcq.q: In the family tree, who is Ahmed?
In the family tree, who is Amna?
What do we ask to know a person's name in the tree?
Which word is the opposite of big?
mcq.why: Small is the opposite of big.

mcq.q: A picture shows a girl with red hair. Which sentence is right?
mcq.why: A girl with red hair: She's got red hair.

mcq.q: Your friend asks: Who's Mazin? (your brother)
mcq.why: A brother is a boy: He's my brother.
Grandma is a woman: She's got grey hair.
Mum is a woman, so we say She's my mum.

mcq.q: "She's got big eyes. He's got small eyes." What is different?
mcq.why: Big and small tell us the size.

mcq.q: Which word is the odd one out?
mcq.why: Mouth is a face word; the others are family words.
